name: San Francisco
blurb: Every street is uphill, including the downhill ones. The fog has a residential permit.

signs.text: PARK CUT. Flatter. Muddier. Unfunded.
STAIR ALLEY: KEEP RIGHT. No vehicles. Especially yours.
YIELD TO CABLE CARS. They cannot yield to you.
STEEP GRADE: 4 BLOCKS. Then a steeper one.
STREET CLEANING TUESDAY 6 AM. Ticketing began Monday.
2 HR PARKING. 0 SPACES. 7 am to 6 pm.
BRIDGE TOLL $9. View not included.
ROBOTAXI ZONE. Do not place cones on hoods.
BUS STOP: SHUTTLES ONLY. Buses by appointment.
VISIBILITY 200 FT. Summer has begun.
CURB YOUR WHEELS. Your car wants to leave.
NO PARKING, NO STOPPING. No reason given.
CABLE CAR TRACKS. Grip is for the car, not you.
THIS INTERSECTION IS IN BETA. Report crashes to the cable car.
NO TURNS. Pivots by appointment.
RIGHT LANE CLOSED. Product launch in progress.
WALK SIGNAL DEPRECATED. Walking is a legacy feature.
CABLE CAR CROSSING. It has seniority.
LOADING ZONE: SERVERS ONLY. Humans unload elsewhere.
CAMPUS AHEAD. Badge in to continue.
RING LIGHT PARKING ONLY. 15 minutes. Golden hour excepted.
MURAL ALLEY. No drones. The walls have seen enough content.
SPONSORED WALL. Sponsorship ended this morning.
SCAFFOLD AHEAD. Painters have right of way. And rollers.
WET PAINT. Do not stay tuned.

billboards.text: SLEEP AS A SERVICE. First 8 hours free.
WE REINVENTED THE BUS. $40M raised. It's a bus.
NOW HIRING: PROMPT WHISPERER. Senior role. 10 years' experience required.
AI FOR YOUR AI. Delegatron writes the prompts for your other AI.
TOAST, THOUGHT THROUGH. Toastwise reasons it step by step.
ROBOTAXI ARRIVING: 4 MIN. Since 9 am. Emptyseat.
RENT A GPU HOUR. Now just the price of a studio.
YOUR FRIDGE HAS OPINIONS. Coldcase, now with a chatbot. Series B.
AGI BY TUESDAY. Which Tuesday is confidential.
NOW RAISING SERIES Z. We ran out of letters, not money.
WE ARE INEVITABLE. That's the whole ad.

landingLines.text: TEN OUT OF TEN, SAYS A SEA LION
THE FOG GIVES IT A SEVEN
A CABLE CAR RANG ONCE. HIGH PRAISE.
A ROBOTAXI LOGGED IT AS AN INCIDENT

smashables.note: Run W-T. City parking meters along the kerb.
Run W-T. An invented startup's pop-up desk parked on the pavement. Startups only, never Chinatown's shops (pitch deck).
Run W-T. Pavement cafe tables. Never Chinatown's shops (pitch deck).
Run W-U. A pop-up renting ring lights to film in front of the murals: the streaming outfit's crowd, never the neighbourhood's own shops.

meta.notes: Region pack region-sf (playtest 1c, 2026-09-30). The palette keys follow the renderer's material names (sky, water, road, shoulder, land, rail, markingCenter) plus fog and the row-house and cable-car colours, which paint the row-house and cable-car models (W-O, 2026-10-01); `fogBank` lays fog banks offshore. Chapter 3 assumes the Pacific Northwest is chapter 2 ("Pnw and sf first"); the order is the maintainer's call. The mix names three region vehicles (placeholder shapes from the base presets) beside base traffic; a kind listed nowhere never spawns. Every sign and billboard is placed by a billboard slot on the sf-hills or sf-downtown roads. Run W-R (interview, 2026-10-02: "SF first = downtown towers"; playtest 2: the cable cars drove "including in forests"): the downtown network joins with its own signs and billboards, and the cable car leaves the traffic mix, so cable cars run only on downtown's steep cable-car cross streets (render/downtown.ts), never on a race road. Run W-U (the pitch deck after playtest 2, #8: "the Mission's mural alleys"): the mural network joins with its own signs (`mi-` ids, on its shopfront sidewalks); parking meters and cafe tables also stand on its shopfront sidewalks, beside a ring-light pop-up of its own.
